title: Complete Classification of Self-Equivalences
summary: Affine, linear, and affine-quadratic self-equivalence subsets are already large enough, but finding all self-equivalences remains open.

formal_statement.body: Since the affine, linear, and affine-quadratic self-equivalence subsets are large enough, we did not focus on finding all the self-equivalences and we leave it as an open problem.

scope.domain: Algebraic structures and self-equivalences in white-box ARX cryptography.

citations.label: Implicit White-Box Implementations: White-Boxing ARX Ciphers

progress.summary: The paper states that the affine, linear, and affine-quadratic subsets were large enough that it did not pursue all self-equivalences, explicitly leaving that task open.
citation_labels: Adrián Ranea et al., Implicit White-Box Implementations: White-Boxing ARX Ciphers
